name: Raynos
source:
Raynos (full name is Raynos Amtingale) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Raynos is an adult almost fully purple red-eyed om'verai. Raynos' belly is covered with light plates and his chest is covered by dark ones. Raynos' wing membranes are pale, a back side of head is covered with spiky "hair", as well as Raynos has a thin "beard".
Raynos is calm and good with his sons, as well as supportive. Raynos often gifts both of his sons with different gifts. Often uses poetry and metaphoric sentences when speaks.
